48.original: In order to undertake this quest, you must first meet the following requirements:

49.original: 1. FINAL FANTASY XIV: Dawntrail must be registered to your service account.<hex:02100103>2. You must be a beastmaster.<hex:02100103>3. You must have befriended at least twenty-five beasts.

50.original: <hex:02080EE905FF054C616479FF0453657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I have exciting news to share about the Crucible.

51.original: A new board has been added! One fit for only the most talented masters of combat.

52.original: Lady Lauda seems happier than ever. The souls of the Crucible are thriving, she says, and this new board affords ambitious beasts space to spread their wings─quite literally, where applicable!

53.original: Furthermore, I <hex:021A020203>distinctly<hex:021A020103> heard her mention that the final challenger will be a most formidable dragon known as “Borgny the Venomous.”

54.original: How's that for observation? I may yet be a fledgling of the craft, but you must admit that I have a keen sense for detail!

55.original: One day I shall be venturing into the Crucible beside you, <hex:02080EE905FF054C616479FF0453657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Oh, what a day that will be... Until then, keep doing us proud!

56.original: The First Master's Board has been unlocked. To challenge it, speak with Lauda in Bentbranch Meadows.

57.original: Furthermore, new wares are now available from the Kornago merchant.
